title: T1055.003 — Process Injection - Thread Execution Hijacking
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Process Injection - Thread Execution Hijacking with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated story of thread execution hijacking: an implant opens a browser process, suspends a thread, writes shellcode, redirects the instruction pointer, resumes the thread, and the SOC detects it.

steps.title: Foothold
steps.caption: A user downloads a malicious file, and the implant starts on the workstation. Nothing on screen looks wrong.
steps.defender: Sysmon Event ID 1 records the new process with a suspicious parent chain.
